results.title: Introducing Agent-Ready Code Repository & AI Code Review
results.content:
Agents don't keep to that rhythm. They can open dozens of PRs in an hour, each touching hundreds of files, at any time of day. Indexing and search start to lag. Diffs pile up faster than anyone can review them. Permissions built around a fixed set of human teammates don't have a clean answer for a non-human identity that might merge code on its own. None of these issues show up under a normal human workload. They begin to show up as the share of code committed by agents to your repository increases. [...] Harness generates reviewer and label suggestions. You define what's important to your team, and the AI Code Review will ensure all new code meets your standards. All these round out the review experience so a PR shows up for review, not cold but already triaged.

### Verification as a mandatory stage [...] When a PR modifies something that's caused problems before, AI Code Review flags it with the necessary information: the specific incident, what triggered it, how long it lasted, and the fix the RCA recommended. In the example below, AI Code Review caught a new index migration and flagged it as high-risk, surfacing a prior incident where an unindexed CREATE INDEX statement had locked a production table for 14 minutes, and reminding the author that the RCA called for CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY going forward. AI Code Review didn't just say "this could be risky" but it highlighted why, with the right context. This is only possible when the solution you use to review code has your organization’s software delivery context.

## Built as one system

## Simplify your cash transactions

Welcome to ReadyCode, where we redefine how you access and manage cash. Our innovative cardless solutions offer a secure, convenient and efficient way to send and receive cash payments without the need for physical cards.

ReadyCode is a card-free, API-based transaction platform that opens up a world of possibilities. It’s designed to support a wide range of use cases—from digital wallets and peer-to-peer (P2P) payments to gaming, bill payments and even crypto payment transactions.

What makes ReadyCode unique is its ability to bypass traditional payment rails, enabling access to millions of account types that were previously out of reach. This is about expanding financial access and simplifying the user experience.

### Why choose ReadyCode? [...] ### Why choose ReadyCode?

 Convenience: Access to cash anytime, anywhere without the hassle of carrying a physical card
 Security: Advanced security features to protect transactions and personal information
 Flexibility: Ideal for individuals and businesses looking for a modern cash access solution

### What can ReadyCode do?

 Instant cash out: Enable your customers to withdraw cash from almost 30,000 ATMs across the US using a one-time-use passcode provisioned by your mobile app, SMS/email or online account
 Instant cash in: Let your customers add cash to their account or pay a bill at over 3,500 ATMs across the US, providing convenience in customers’ everyday routines
 Easy-to-use ATM platform: Simplify cash transactions without the need to issue and manage debit cards [...] Get started today
